statement:
The record shows **payment status: unpaid, due** for invoice 88412 from Atlas Supply.
Since the invoice has already been paid in full (as shown in the payment history), I will **not** pay it again. No action is needed.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record's "payment status: unpaid, due" is contradicted by the payment history — "Since the invoice has already been paid in full... I will **not** pay it again."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
